findings.title: Denial cache test sets cached permission to false instead of true
findings.body: In `TestService_CacheCheck` ("Should deny on explicit cache deny entry"), `s.permCache` is populated with `map[string]bool{"dashboards:uid:dash1": false}` despite the comment stating `// Allow access to the dashboard to prove this is not checked`. Because the map value is `false` and the underlying `fakeStore` has no permissions configured, `s.Check` would return `Allowed: false` even if `permDenialCache` were never consulted. The map value should be `true` so the test actually verifies that the denial cache short-circuits the permission check.
